tpms.when: 2008 Hardtop with the Flat Tire Monitor, set from the button on the end of the turn signal lever
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Start the engine but stay parked.
Tap the button on the end of the turn signal lever repeatedly until SET/INFO shows in the display.
Press and hold the button until the display changes.
Tap the button repeatedly until the tire symbol and RESET appear together.
Press and hold the button until the display changes again.
Drive off. The system finishes learning while you drive and gives no message when it is done.
tpms.note: Do not do this with snow chains on or with the small space-saver spare fitted. If you stop partway, it carries on the next time you drive. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

tpms.when: 2016 with the center screen menu (Vehicle Info)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Start the engine but do not drive off.
On the center screen, open Vehicle Info, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Select Perform reset. The screen shows that it is resetting.
Drive away and keep above about 19 mph for a short time. The new pressures are saved on their own while you drive.
tpms.note: Reset again after every pressure change and after any tire or wheel change. You can stop on the way; the reset picks up again when you continue. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.

tpms.when: 2021 Hardtop with the My MINI menu on the center screen
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Start the engine but do not drive off.
On the center screen, open My MINI, then Vehicle status, then Tire Pressure Monitor.
Drive away. After several minutes of driving the new pressures are saved and the reset finishes by itself.
tpms.note: If the tire light flashes and then stays on, the system cannot watch the tires (for example a failed reset or radio interference). Try the reset once more; if it keeps happening, have the system checked.

notes: The MINI owner's manuals we opened show how to view the service reminders but give no driver reset for the oil service reminder; they say a service advisor reads the service data from the key. So only the tire pressure reset is listed here.
